audiences.title: Two ways to work with us

creators.label: Creators
creators.title: You create, we get your clips out there
creators.lead: Streamers, podcasters, video makers: keep doing your long-form content, we handle the short formats.

points.one: We watch your streams and long videos for you
points.two: Vertical clips, edited and captioned, with a hook
points.three: Published every day on dedicated accounts
points.four: A space to approve clips and track views

clippers.label: Clippers
clippers.title: You edit, join the team
clippers.lead: You can spot a great moment and make it land in 30 seconds? We're looking for reliable editors.

points.one: Source videos and clear briefs, ready to edit
points.three: A pace that fits your availability
points.four: Regular feedback to help you improve

services.title: From raw stream to published clip
services.lead: The whole chain is handled by the team. You stay in control of what goes out.

moments.title: Finding the moments
moments.body: We watch your long-form content and isolate the parts that hook.

editing.title: Vertical editing
editing.body: 9:16 reframing, pacing, readable captions and clean styling.

hooks.title: Hooks and captions
hooks.body: A first second that holds attention, a caption and fitting hashtags.

accounts.title: Dedicated accounts
accounts.body: TikTok, Reels and Shorts accounts created and managed in your name.

publishing.title: Scheduled publishing
publishing.body: Clips published regularly, when your audience is active.

reporting.title: Results tracking
reporting.body: Views, followers gained and upcoming clips, visible in your space.

clippers.title: You know how to make a clip that holds? Join the team.
clippers.lead: We work with remote clippers, paid for each mission. Apply in two minutes.

test.body: We send you an excerpt to cut so we can see your style and speed.

missions.body: You receive videos and briefs in your space, and deliver your clips.
